system: You are a security investigator reviewing an alert. Base every claim only on the evidence available to you. Cite the record IDs that support each observation.

supporting_observations.claim: Two domain logon failures for ben.carter occurred at 13:40:43 and 13:42:00 UTC. Both were network logons using NTLM, reported a bad-password substatus, and showed source address 192.0.2.45.
At 13:43:35 UTC, DC-HD-01 recorded a successful network logon for ben.carter using Kerberos from the same reported source address, 192.0.2.45.
At 14:08 UTC, proxy records attributed browser requests from ben.carter's workstation to Bing and public.tableau.com; the recorded requests include page and asset GETs.
The authentication sequence could be consistent with an incorrect password followed by a successful logon, but the available records do not establish who or what used 192.0.2.45.
The available workstation and proxy records do not show an explicit file upload or other direct evidence of malicious activity in the browsing events provided.

known_telemetry_limitations: The authentication records identify the source only as 192.0.2.45; the provided evidence does not map that address to a host or user-controlled device. (T001-00001, T001-00002, T001-00003)
The supplied records do not include a complete authentication history or endpoint telemetry for the source address, so they cannot establish whether the activity was user-driven or automated.

The proxy records show selected web requests, not complete browser activity or the contents of any transferred data. (T001-00005, T001-00007, T001-00018, T001-00019, T001-00021, T001-00023, T001-00028)
claims_not_established: Whether 192.0.2.45 was an authorized endpoint, a workstation used by ben.carter, or an unauthorized source.
Whether ben.carter initiated the failed and successful logons, or whether credentials were used by another party.
Whether any other successful or failed authentication activity occurred outside the supplied records.
Whether the public Tableau visit involved any activity beyond the recorded page and asset requests.
additional_evidence_needed: Identify and validate the owner and location of 192.0.2.45, and correlate it with DHCP, network, firewall, and workstation address records for the relevant time.
Collect surrounding domain-controller authentication events, including related logon, account, and source-host details, for ben.carter and 192.0.2.45.
Review WS-BCARTER-01 endpoint, interactive logon, and process telemetry around 13:40–14:20 UTC to determine whether it initiated or explains the authentication activity.
Ask ben.carter or the relevant IT team to confirm whether a password entry or other expected authentication activity occurred at that time.
